import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_matmul_tiled_(lhsT, rhs):
    M = lhsT.shape[1]
    N = rhs.shape[1]
    K = lhsT.shape[0]
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((M, N), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate SBUF for stationary and moving operands
    sbuf_stationary = nl.ndarray((K, M), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sbuf_moving = nl.ndarray((K, N), dtype=rhs.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy lhsT to sbuf_stationary
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_stationary, src=lhsT)
    
    # Copy rhs to sbuf_moving
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_moving, src=rhs)
    
    # Allocate PSUM buffer for matmul result
    psum = nl.ndarray((M, N), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    # Perform NC matmul
    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum, stationary=sbuf_stationary, moving=sbuf_moving)
    
    # Copy result from PSUM to SBUF
    sbuf_out = nl.ndarray((M, N), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=sbuf_out, src=psum)
    
    # Copy result from SBUF to shared HBM
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=sbuf_out)
    
    return out
